# Code of Conduct

Precedence follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
It applies to everyone who takes part in this project, in issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and anywhere
else you represent the project.

## In short

- Be kind, and assume good faith. Critique the work, not the person.
- Welcome newcomers. Explain terms instead of assuming them; [`CONTEXT.md`](../CONTEXT.md) is there to point to.
- No harassment, insults, personal or political attacks, or sexualized language or imagery.
- Don't publish anyone's private information without their explicit permission.
- Accept responsibility for mistakes, apologize to the people affected, and learn from them.

## Reporting

If someone's behavior worries you, tell a maintainer privately: [@I0B0M](https://github.com/I0B0M) or
[@blondres04](https://github.com/blondres04). If you can't find a private way to reach us, open an issue that says
you'd like to be contacted, without any details, and we'll reply privately. Reports are kept confidential.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code, issues and other contributions that don't follow this
code. Depending on the impact, they may respond with a private correction, a warning, a temporary ban, or a permanent
ban, following the Contributor Covenant's
[enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines).

## Attribution
